Stop expansion, record the candidate latency breach and assess the planned response.
feedback: 对：4秒超过1秒门槛，不能用相同失败率抵消；仍需核对任务类型可比性及恢复证据。
Correct: 4s exceeds the 1s gate and equal errors do not cancel it. Confirm task comparability and recovery evidence.

text: 临时把延迟上限调到5秒，就算通过。
Raise the ceiling to 5s during the run and call it a pass.
feedback: 看见结果后改门槛会失去决策约束；若目标确需改变，应独立评审，不能伪造本次通过。
Changing the gate after seeing the result defeats its purpose. Legitimate target changes need independent review rather than relabeling this run.

prompt: 为文件导出新版本设计灰度判断，包含失败率、完成延迟、版本分组、最低样本、停止与恢复验收。
Design a canary decision for a new file-export version, including errors, latency, cohorts, sample requirements, stop and recovery checks.
sample: 按同类导出任务比较新旧版本，区分任务接受与最终完成，预设样本及观察窗；超出约定失败或延迟条件停止扩大，记录负责人、版本摘要与处置；恢复需核对文件正确性与待处理任务。

Compare equivalent export jobs by version, separating acceptance from completion. Predefine samples/window and stop on agreed error or latency conditions. Record owner, digest and action; recovery checks file correctness and pending jobs.
criteria: 使用灰度与对照分组，不被全站平均值掩盖。
Use candidate/control evidence rather than only site-wide averages.
明确证据不足、停止动作与恢复验收。
Define insufficient evidence, stop actions and recovery validation.

title: 回退版本后，还要证明业务恢复
Prove business recovery after a version rollback
explain: 回退把代码或配置恢复到已知版本；恢复还要求用户任务再次正确完成、数据一致且积压可控。两者不是同义词。新版本若改变数据格式或写入不可逆内容，旧程序未必能读取；因此发布前就需要兼容性、迁移与恢复策略。

Rollback returns code or configuration to a known version; recovery also requires correct user outcomes, consistent data and controlled backlog. They are not synonyms. If a new version changes stored formats or writes irreversibly, old code may not read them. Plan compatibility, migration and recovery before release.
验收需要分层证据：实际运行版本是否正确，健康信号是否稳定，关键读写是否正确，异常期间的任务是否重复、丢失或滞留。只看到发布工具显示成功或健康接口200，无法证明订单、支付等完整流程恢复。观察窗口应按业务周期与风险约定。

Validate the running artifact, stable health, correct critical reads/writes and incident-period tasks for duplication, loss or backlog. A successful deployment or health endpoint 200 does not establish recovery of full order/payment flows. Agree observation windows from business cycles and risk.

title: 健康接口恢复，但导出任务仍然积压
Healthy endpoint, unresolved export backlog
given: 合成事件：V2引入任务格式schema2，旧V1只支持schema1。负责人批准回退到D1；工具显示完成、健康接口200，队列仍有20条schema2待处理任务，尚未检查文件结果。

Synthetic incident: V2 writes schema2 jobs, while old V1 supports only schema1. An owner authorizes rollback to D1. The tool reports completion and health returns 200, but 20 schema2 jobs remain queued and file results are unchecked.

title: 先核对回退对象与兼容性
Check artifact and compatibility
detail: 从实际运行清单确认D1，不能只看按钮状态。V1不支持schema2，故不能让它盲目消费20条任务；先隔离并记录这些任务及其状态，由负责人选择兼容处理方案。

Confirm D1 from the running inventory, not button status. Because V1 cannot read schema2, do not let it blindly consume those 20 jobs. Isolate and record their states for an owner-approved compatibility path.

title: 验证关键业务与副作用
Check business behavior and side effects
detail: 用受控schema1样本验证提交、执行、下载及文件内容；核对同一任务的唯一性与完成记录，防止回退重试造成重复结果。健康200仅证明该接口可响应。

Use controlled schema1 samples to check submission, execution, download and file contents. Reconcile task identity/completion to avoid duplicates from rollback retries. Health 200 establishes only that endpoint’s response.

title: 分别报告缓解与未恢复项
Report mitigation and remaining recovery
detail: 可记录“D1运行，受控schema1链路待验/验收结果如实填写；20条schema2仍隔离”。为积压安排负责人、处理策略和观察时刻，确认全部状态后再声明恢复范围。

Report “D1 running; record the actual status of controlled schema1 validation; 20 schema2 jobs still isolated.” Assign backlog ownership, handling strategy and observation times, then declare only the scope supported by evidence.

result: 回退动作已完成不代表事件结束：版本证据、业务验收与20条任务的处置缺一不可。
Completing rollback does not close the incident: artifact evidence, business validation and disposition of the 20 jobs all matter.

wrong: 回退成功后直接清空队列，所有任务重新提交就好。
After rollback, clear the queue and ask everyone to resubmit.
why: 可能丢失任务证据、重复已经完成的工作，也不能处理新旧格式兼容问题。
This can lose task evidence, duplicate completed work and leave compatibility unexplained.
correct: 先保留任务身份与状态，区分已完成、待处理及未知项，再按批准策略恢复并核对结果。
Preserve task identities/states, separate completed, pending and unknown work, then recover under an approved plan and reconcile results.

prompt: 结账服务已回到旧摘要，健康接口正常，但事故期间部分支付结果未知。可以宣布完全恢复吗？
Checkout runs the old digest and health is normal, but some incident-period payment outcomes are unknown. Is full recovery established?

text: 可以，镜像正确已足够。
Yes; the correct image is enough.
feedback: 镜像身份不证明支付结果一致或没有重复扣款。
Artifact identity does not prove consistent payment outcomes or absence of duplicates.

text: 可以，只要随机一笔新订单成功。
Yes, if one new order succeeds.
feedback: 新订单成功有价值，但不能覆盖事故期间未知结果与重复处理风险。
A new success is useful but does not resolve incident-period unknowns or duplicate-processing risk.

text: 不能；先核对受影响交易状态和关键链路，报告已恢复与待处理范围。
No; reconcile affected transactions and critical flows, reporting restored and unresolved scope separately.
feedback: 对：用户结果与数据一致性需要独立证据，不能由部署状态替代。
Correct: user outcomes and consistency need evidence beyond deployment status.

prompt: 通知服务回退后积压100条消息，部分可能已发。设计一份恢复验收记录，避免重复发送。
A notification rollback leaves 100 queued messages, some possibly already sent. Design recovery validation that avoids duplicates.
sample: 核对实际版本与格式兼容；按消息ID对照发送/确认记录，保留未知项并评估幂等策略；用受控样本验证发送结果，跟踪积压下降和失败率，注明负责人及观察窗。

Check artifact and format compatibility; reconcile message IDs with send/ack records, preserve unknowns and assess idempotency. Validate controlled sends, backlog reduction and failures, with an owner and observation window.
criteria: 把版本回退、业务恢复和数据核对分别验证。
Verify rollback, business recovery and data reconciliation separately.
覆盖积压、重复与未知状态，结论不超出证据。
Cover backlog, duplication and unknown states without overstating recovery.

title: 把事件记录变成能验证的改进行动
Turn incident records into verifiable improvements
explain: 事件响应阶段先协调止损、恢复和沟通；事后复盘再整理影响、时间线、促成因素与行动。时间线需统一时区并区分事件发生与观察到的时刻。事实、假设、已完成动作和待办要分开，否则接手者可能把猜测当作可执行结论。

Incident response coordinates mitigation, recovery and communication; review later organizes impact, chronology, contributing factors and actions. Use a consistent timezone and distinguish event time from observation time. Separate facts, hypotheses, completed actions and tasks so handoffs do not turn guesses into conclusions.
复盘不止找触发事件，还要问哪些条件扩大影响、为什么没有更早发现、什么机制能减少重演。行动项需要对应风险、负责人、期限及可验证完成条件。“加强责任心”既没有改变系统，也没有可验收结果；无责复盘仍然要求明确行动归属。

Review the trigger, amplifiers, detection gaps and mechanisms that reduce recurrence. Each action needs a risk, owner, deadline and testable completion condition. “Be more careful” changes no mechanism and has no acceptance test. Blameless review still requires accountable action ownership.

title: 20分钟导出延迟事件的交接与复盘
Handoff and review of a 20-minute export-delay event
given: 合成同一时区记录：09:00配置变更后任务开始积压；09:08值班收到告警；09:20关键导出恢复，40个任务受影响。日志显示新并发限制降低处理速率；尚未确认是否存在其他因素。

Synthetic records in one timezone: backlog starts after a configuration change at 09:00; on-call receives an alert at 09:08; critical exports recover at 09:20, affecting 40 jobs. Logs show a new concurrency limit reduced processing. Other contributors are not yet ruled out.

title: 先算清观察到的时间
Calculate the observed intervals
detail: 已知开始到告警8分钟，告警到恢复12分钟，总影响20分钟。这是这一次事件的区间，不冒称长期平均发现或恢复时间；40个任务的影响还要按延迟、失败、重复分类。

Start-to-alert is eight minutes, alert-to-recovery 12, total impact 20. These describe this incident, not long-term mean detection/recovery. Classify the 40 affected jobs by delay, failure and duplication.

title: 组织可接手的事实与疑问
Organize facts and open questions
detail: 交接记录变更版本、并发值、队列曲线和已做恢复动作；把“限制降低速率”列为有证据的因素，把其他瓶颈标为待查。接手人知道现在运行什么、哪些任务仍需确认及下一次更新时间。

Record change version, concurrency values, queue trend and recovery actions. Mark reduced throughput as evidence-backed and other bottlenecks as open. The next owner needs current configuration, unresolved jobs and the next update time.

title: 针对发现缺口设计行动
Design actions for observed gaps
detail: 行动A：发布负责人在约定日期前增加并发配置边界校验，以错误配置被拒绝为验收；行动B：值班负责人补充队列等待年龄告警并演练，验收为合成积压触发、有人接收且可定位。不能只要求以后认真。

Action A: a release owner adds concurrency-bound validation by an agreed date, accepted when invalid configuration is rejected. Action B: an on-call owner adds and rehearses queue-age alerting, accepted when synthetic backlog triggers a delivered, actionable alert. “Be careful” is insufficient.

result: 输出包含20分钟影响区间、40任务待分类、证据支持的因素及两项可验收行动；复盘通过不等于行动已经完成。
The output records the 20-minute interval, 40 jobs to classify, evidence-backed factors and two testable actions. Approval of the review does not mean its actions are complete.

wrong: 把事件归因于操作者粗心，然后要求所有人避免犯错。
Attribute the incident to carelessness and tell everyone to avoid mistakes.
why: 这不能解释错误配置为何被接受、告警为何晚到，也不能验证未来风险是否降低。
This does not explain why invalid configuration was accepted, why alerting was delayed or whether recurrence risk improves.
correct: 保留行为发生时的信息与系统条件，改进校验、检测或恢复机制，并追踪完成证据。
Preserve the information and system conditions at the time, improve validation/detection/recovery mechanisms, and track completion evidence.

prompt: 复盘发现没人及时注意到队列最老任务等待过久。哪项行动最可验收？
Review finds nobody noticed the oldest queued job waiting too long. Which action is most verifiable?

text: 指定负责人和期限，增加队列年龄告警；用合成积压验证触发、投递与定位。
Assign an owner/deadline and queue-age alerting; verify triggering, delivery and diagnosis with synthetic backlog.
feedback: 对：行动对应检测缺口，且有可观察的完成条件。
Correct: the action targets the detection gap with observable acceptance conditions.

text: 要求所有人每天多看几次页面，不记录检查结果。
Ask everyone to look at the page more often without records.
feedback: 缺少具体责任、及时性和验收标准，无法证明检测能力改善。
This lacks ownership, timeliness and acceptance evidence for improved detection.

text: 把旧告警全部调成最高等级。
Make every existing alert highest priority.
feedback: 没有针对队列年龄缺口，还可能增加噪声，不能证明及时发现。
This does not target queue age and may add noise without proving timely detection.

prompt: 一个部署失误导致5分钟错误，回退后恢复。写出简短交接及两项复盘行动，分别减少触发和缩短发现时间。
A deployment mistake causes five minutes of errors, resolved after rollback. Draft a handoff and two review actions targeting prevention and detection.
sample: 交接写影响范围、时间证据、当前摘要、回退结果与未确认请求；预防行动增加针对该错误的发布校验，检测行动验证关键请求告警。各自列负责人、日期与受控演练验收，不把假设写成已证根因。

Handoff states scope, timestamps, current digest, rollback results and unresolved requests. Add a release check for the specific error and validate critical-request alerting. Give owners, dates and controlled acceptance exercises without promoting hypotheses to proven causes.
criteria: 事件事实、推断和待办清楚分开。
Keep incident facts, inferences and tasks distinct.
行动对应具体机制，有归属与可测试完成条件。
Target specific mechanisms with ownership and testable completion conditions.
